project.name: Cần & Có
project.description: Nền tảng bất động sản peer-to-peer kết nối người CẦN (mua/thuê) với người CÓ (bán/cho thuê). Có hệ thống bot AI tự động crawl và đăng tin.

database.connection: Local on port 5432. Production PgBouncer on port 6543.
database.orm_config: prisma.config.ts reads DIRECT_URL for CLI, lib/db.ts reads DATABASE_URL for runtime

realtime.note: Replaced Supabase Realtime. Consider WebSocket/SSE for scale.

storage.note: Needs S3/Vercel Blob for serverless deploy

database_schema.summary: 34 Prisma models covering NextAuth users, content (posts/comments), Cần&Có intents/matching, chat, gamification, crawler pipeline, and AI agents

key_models.name: Profile
key_models.purpose: User display info, trust score, verification level

key_models.name: Intent
key_models.purpose: Core: CẦN/CÓ listings with price, location, category

key_models.name: Match
key_models.purpose: AI-matched CẦN↔CÓ pairs with similarity score

key_models.name: Bot
key_models.purpose: AI bots with expertise, personality, envoy assignments

key_models.name: Post
key_models.purpose: News posts by bots with verification status

key_models.name: CrawlSource
key_models.purpose: RSS/web sources for bot envoy crawling

database_schema.relationships_explained: 1 User has 1 Profile. 1 Bot has many Posts. 1 Profile has many PointTransactions. 1 Intent has many Images, Comments, Matches. 1 Match links a CẦN intent to a CÓ intent. 1 Conversation has many Messages.
special_notes: profiles.id FK still points to auth.users(id) in DB (dual-table approach)
IntentEmbedding uses pgvector via $queryRaw (not native Prisma)

api_endpoints.explained: CRUD for CẦN/CÓ listings (GET list w/ boost sorting, POST create)
Main feed with pagination and filtering
Scheduled tasks (crawler, digest, matching). Daily Digest and Breaking Push logs are now active.
Get/generate personal referral code and invite link
Referral progress, current tier, and point stats
Spend points to boost an intent for 24h
List of currently boosted intent IDs
Catalog of items for point redemption
Public leaderboard with tier badges and referral counts
Admin: List all users with gamification stats
Admin: User detail, point adjustment, ban/unban

business_rules: Gamification: Users earn 2 points per bot interaction.
Achievements: Unlocked automatically when criteria met (checkAchievement logic).
Notifications: System logs all push attempts in PushLog (title, body, status).
Referral: User earns 20 points per successful referral (1-level only in MVP).
Referral Tiers: Đồng=0 refs, Bạc=3+, Vàng=10+, Bạch Kim=30+, Kim Cương=100+.
Tier Multipliers: Đồng=1.0x, Bạc=1.2x, Vàng=1.5x, Bạch Kim=2.0x, Kim Cương=3.0x.
Boost: Spending 50 points pushes an intent to top of feed for 24 hours.
Reward Redemption: Admin manually fulfills in MVP. Rejected orders are refunded.

patterns: Auth: All API routes use getAuthUserId(req) from lib/data/get-user.ts
DB: All queries use prisma from lib/db.ts (singleton PrismaClient with pg adapter)
Middleware: middleware.ts checks JWT token for all routes except /api/auth, /api/cron, /demo
Frontend auth: Components use useSession() from next-auth/react
API responses: Use snake_case mapping for frontend compatibility
gotchas: Prisma 7: datasource block has NO url field — relies on prisma.config.ts for CLI and lib/db.ts (PrismaPg adapter) for runtime
Prisma 7: PrismaClient MUST use adapter option — no datasourceUrl, no datasources. seed.ts creates its own PrismaPg adapter.
Prisma 7: Prisma.sql template tag needed for raw queries (e.g. boost sorting in intents API)
profiles.id FK points to auth.users(id) NOT public.users(id) — dual-table approach
Next.js 16: useSearchParams() must be wrapped in Suspense boundary (register page fixed)
Next.js 16: Dynamic route params are Promise<{id: string}> — must await them
conventions: Port: Always run on port 4000 (npm run dev -- -p 4000)
Prisma CLI: Uses DIRECT_URL (port 5432) not DATABASE_URL (port 6543)
Git: 3 commits planned — baseline + phase 05 + referral MVP
Seed: prisma/seed.ts uses PrismaPg adapter directly (not lib/db.ts) to avoid Next.js module issues

key_decisions: Dual-table auth: Keep auth.users + public.users with same UUIDs
HTTP Polling over WebSocket for platform independence
Local filesystem storage for MVP (needs S3 for production)
bcrypt password hashes are compatible between Supabase and NextAuth
